reason: The admin is getting away from me as we grow, and the free move-in and 60-day trial are tempting. But I'm not putting my bookings and driver compliance on software nobody else is running yet, when Coach Manager and my telematics already cover a good part of it.
objection: A new company with no customers. If it falls over halfway through a school excursion season, or they fold in a year, I've had all the upheaval for nothing, and the Excel export won't fix that.
would_change_my_mind: Hearing from another operator my size, say at the bus association regional meeting, who has run it through a busy season and found it clearly beats Coach Manager plus telematics, Xero invoicing included.
